reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed agent's V3 per-platform ladder (bias + steering-gain + 3-sample lag) from the b,k,n parameters reported in out/variant_table_<PLATFORM>.csv and the prediction equation in tools/run_ladder.py.
notes: Favourite model = agent's V3 (per-platform additive ladder: bias b, steering-gain k, integer lag n=3 samples=60 ms applied within each segment). V4 per-segment bias is explicitly labelled by the agent as 'calibration, not model improvement' so excluded. Parameters (b,k) read from out/variant_table_FORD_*.csv: Mach-E b=0.00023 k=1.0948, F-150 b=0.00363 k=0.8672. RMSE pooled over agent_filter (v>2 AND lag-shifted pred finite); this drops the first 3 samples of every segment from the agent score, while V0 baseline uses all qualifying samples — note baseline n_samples and agent n_samples differ slightly. Canonical n_samples_after_filter reflects the full v>2 filter (baseline count).
